name: rail-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-road-regional`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight road through open wheat fields at sunset is instantly recognizable as a road-ahead scene at any phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline 'Regional runs through farm country' is literally illustrated by the road cutting through golden farmland, making a tight, single story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large bold headline sits on a solid dark-blue panel at the top, the outlined button sits clearly below it, and the photo occupies the lower half without competing with the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep navy (#1F3A5F) dominates the top panel and footer, white type and button border are on-brand, but no company logo appears anywhere in the ad.
